other_conditions: Only workers not covered under the Employees' Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 are eligible
Initially only one person per family can obtain benefits
Family income is calculated as the average over the 12 months preceding the application month
The family includes the beneficiary, spouse, wholly dependent daughters, wholly dependent minor sons and wholly dependent parents
The major source of income of the beneficiary and family members must be from wage‑employment or self‑employment in unorganized sectors
benefits_summary: Provides a matching contribution and interest that is refunded at age 60 or upon death or permanent total disability, creating a financial safety net for unorganized workers in Tripura.
documents_required: Certificate issued by the concerned authority (e.g., Pradhan of the Gram Panchayat, CEO of Municipal Council, Mayor/Deputy Mayor, Member of Panchayat Samiti, or employer)
